title: A fence probe turn is claimed without a cpu queue race
description:
As a household member, I want the named fence probe to start a turn without publishing a cpu SQS job, so the exercise can acquire the lease and prove second-claim 409 instead of losing to the computerless worker.

Feature: Channels and the message store

Scenario: A probe message can start a turn without enqueueing cpu work
  Given an empty control plane with a cpu enqueue hook
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Assistant
  When user ryan posts a fence probe addressed to Assistant without enqueueing a turn job
  Then the channel has a turn
  And bot Assistant has 0 pending turns
  And the cpu enqueue hook was not invoked

Not included: staging, production, Fargate.
